title: Automate changelog and onboard cobalt-13b-v1.0 performance profiles and metadata
author: Priya Sharma
description: Adds onboarding metadata and performance profiles for cobalt-13b v1.0 and introduces an automated changelog entry generator that surfaces model metadata and perf highlights. Motivation: reduce manual churn when adding new models and ensure changelogs are consistent across releases. Changes include: 1) canonical metadata JSON for cobalt-13b v1.0 (architecture, tokenizer, validation checksums, recommended quantization profiles), 2) perf profiles (latency/throughput matrices across our representative hardware targets and sequence lengths), 3) CI integration to validate perf profile schema and run a lightweight perf sanity check in the model-registry pipeline, and 4) a small automation script that composes release notes from model metadata + perf highlights and appends to the changelog in the repository. Checklist: [x] metadata schema validated [x] perf profiles added [x] automation script implemented [x] CI jobs wired up [x] docs updated with onboarding steps. This PR is intended to be the template for future automatic onboarding and changelog generation for other models.
